entries.827b9dbefdb5e3ec: In the Detached House Sales Business, the company will consider the supply-demand balance by area and proceed with a focus on profit growth. It will expand maintenance and renovation business for purchasing customers and income-producing property businesses, including built-for-rent detached houses, to stabilize revenue, and will also expand condominium sales and contract construction to give breadth to its business. It will invest cash generated from the domestic real estate business in expanding its overseas business, which it positions as a growth business, and in research and development aimed at improving housing safety, environmental and livability performance and labor-saving in construction. Targeting the fiscal year ending March 2030, it sets management indicators in its guidelines, including an organic growth rate of 4.0% and a detached house sales dependency ratio of 70.0% (the guidelines state that these are not a guarantee of achievement).

entries.a1f090f1b7c25ab8: Profit attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥63,315 million, up 24.9% year on year. The supply-demand balance in the built-for-sale detached house market remained favorable, and an environment in which profit was easier to secure continued. On the other hand, inventory at the beginning of the period was somewhat low relative to the annual sales plan, and because the company prioritized profit and did not force sales volume, the number of houses sold decreased from the previous year.
